title: ScreenSave
description: Bouncing DVD thing when you go AFK for longer than a minute
body:
Screens are precious.

Screens need to be cared for.

You don't want burn-in inside of your monitor, right?

## Presenting ScreenSave!
ScreenSave is a never before seen idea, where it quite literally just implements the DVD Bouncing screen into Minecraft! (Cool Transition Here) Not only will it appear after a minute of being AFK, but any movement or key inputs will ALSO make the screen dissapear, just like MAGIC!

## Features
- Bounces
- Changes Colors
- MIGHT Hit Corners (ooooooh~)

![Cool picture of the DVD logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfba243ace565294b4ca97174d94709b49b7b593.png)

This mod took 581 years (definitely...) to make so please donate to me on Ko-Fi!
